# GitHub Copilot instructions

The repository's agent instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the root. Follow that file when generating or reviewing code; this file only points to it so the rules exist in one place.

When reviewing a pull request, follow [`REVIEW.md`](../REVIEW.md) at the root: it defines what to look for, the Important/Nit/Pre-existing tags, the nit cap, paths to skip, and the summary format.
